articles.title: Why are early warning systems failing in the Himalayas despite rising disaster risks?
articles.description: The Himalayas are facing increasingly frequent and intense disasters, but experts warn that existing early warning systems are struggling to detect fast-moving and complex hazards. The recent Nepal glacier-triggered flash flood has highlighted gaps in monitoring, data availability and community preparedness.
